definitions: A system of religious veneration and devotion directed towards a particular figure or object.
A relatively small group of people having religious beliefs or practices regarded by others as strange or sinister.
A person or thing that is popular or fashionable among a particular group or section of society.
A devoted interest in and enthusiasm for a thing, especially one with a limited following.
examples: The cult of personality surrounding the leader.
They joined a cult in their youth.
The cult of fitness is growing.
